sentences.text:
This criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the FIR No. 222/2016 dated 19.08.2016 registered at Police Station Kishangarh, Dist. Ajmer for offences under Sections 406, 420, 447, 427,379 and 120B IPC.
2.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that bare perusal of the content of FIR would not constitute any criminal offence against the petitioner and the petitioner has been falsely implicated.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted the factual report dated 22.09.2025 sent by SHO Police Station Kishangarh, Dist. Ajmer revealing therein that, investigation has been (Uploaded on 09/10/2025 at 11:30:39 AM) [2025:RJ-JP:40701] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4395/2016] conducted by the Investigating Officer and which has resulted in filing of charge-sheet against the petitioner under Sections 420, 406, 447, 427, & 120B IPC, which has been filed on 16.12.2019 in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Kishangarh, Dist. Ajmer.
Thereafter, trial is pending against the petitioner and the next date in the trial is 13.11.2025.
In the factual report, the criminal antecedents of the petitioner have also been given.
